source_clause: EH6.) When AUTO ECO is on, deselect airflow modes as in standard AUTO mode; fan speed indication should denote that AUTO ECO is active.
reasoning: 驗證目標：10.6（EH6）定出 AUTO ECO 作用中時 airflow modes 之取消選取（同標準 AUTO）與風速指示反映 AUTO ECO，兩個 037 leaf 分別對應之，一葉一 TC（§8.2.1）。關鍵情境條件：第十五軸依 R-C29 標 (10.1)；AUTO ECO 之啟動由 procedure 建立；依 R-C34 補第十三軸排除，EMEA ICS 不補。為什麼這樣切：airflow mode 之取消與風速指示為兩個不同位置之可觀察量，失效可各自發生。刻意略過：條文之「as in standard AUTO mode」把取消選取之細節委派予標準 AUTO（2.3，屬 `Climate Modes` 組，尚未生成），故 -01 只驗「airflow modes 被取消選取」此一本節明文之結果，不驗其動畫或順序（§8.2.1）；「fan speed indication should denote that AUTO ECO is active」未給具體樣式，ER 以該詞本身判定（R-C22）。

interface_axis_review.observable_interface: climate screen 之 airflow mode 選取狀態與風速指示
interface_axis_review.axis_9: 不暴露 —— 可觀察量為 climate screen 之 AUTO 控制，非 head unit 之 comfort section
interface_axis_review.axis_12: 不暴露 —— 不觀察 tab
interface_axis_review.axis_13: 暴露 → 全數補（3 旋鈕 ICS 車上無 HVAC 畫面／popup）
interface_axis_review.emea_ics: **不補** —— ch16 十八節無 ECO HVAC 之對應節（`ch16_mirror_map.tsv` 之 ch10 側全無列），排除即無所依據；本組非 no-counterpart 之「已列而無對造」，而是 ch10 從未進入該表之比對範圍，理由相同：ch16 不承載此章之能力

tcs.tc_title: AUTO ECO deselects the airflow modes
tcs.test_item:
EH6.) When AUTO ECO is on, deselect airflow modes as in standard AUTO mode; fan speed indication should denote that AUTO ECO is active.

(The vehicle is an EV vehicle, on which ECO HVAC is used; press the AUTO button until the AUTO ECO mode is active)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle is an EV vehicle, on which ECO HVAC is used (10.1)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Select an airflow mode on the climate screen
2. Press the AUTO button until the AUTO ECO mode is active
tcs.expected_result:
1. The selected airflow mode is shown as selected
2. The airflow modes are deselected
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.test_item_authored: When AUTO ECO is on, the system shall deselect airflow modes as in standard AUTO mode

tcs.tc_title: Fan speed indication denotes AUTO ECO is active
tcs.test_item:
EH6.) When AUTO ECO is on, deselect airflow modes as in standard AUTO mode; fan speed indication should denote that AUTO ECO is active.

(The vehicle is an EV vehicle, on which ECO HVAC is used; read the fan speed indication on the climate screen)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle is an EV vehicle, on which ECO HVAC is used (10.1)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press the AUTO button until the AUTO ECO mode is active
2. Read the fan speed indication on the climate screen
tcs.expected_result:
1. The AUTO ECO mode is active
2. The fan speed indication denotes that AUTO ECO is active
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.test_item_authored: When AUTO ECO is on, the fan speed indication shall denote that AUTO ECO is active
